issues.where: whole frame, across all three stroke sheets
issues.what: the globe does not move during the shake: it stays seated and centered on the surface with no strokes, no reversals, no lagging tilt; the only change is the interior fogging up, so the shake reads as a fog build in a weightless globe sitting on a table, not a heavy thing in a hand
issues.fix: animate the globe as a held mass: unequal horizontal strokes with sharp reversals, a tilt that lags the hand, and let the shadow, reflection and base contact answer it

issues.where: the whole lift, 0.00 s to 0.57 s
issues.what: the lift never happens: the globe stays seated on the surface for the full run, base contact, snow scatter, shadow and reflection essentially unchanged; there is no rise and no sense of effort
issues.fix: raise the globe off the surface across the lift with a slow first effort and a clean break of contact, and drop the contact shadow as it leaves the table

issues.where: frames at 1.47 s to 1.60 s, center of the frame
issues.what: a mid-strokes pop: the frosted storm globe suddenly flares warm orange and reads as smooth unfrosted glass, the scattered snow on the surface vanishes, then everything snaps back to cold and frosted ~0.2 s later; visible at normal speed
issues.fix: remove the lighting swap; keep color temperature, frost texture and ground snow continuous through those frames

issues.what: the set down is missing: the globe is already seated at 1.80 s and never descends, lands, bounces or settles; the run is only the fog thinning
issues.fix: show a short descent with a soft impact, one small settle wobble in the base, and a matching twitch in shadow and reflection

issues.where: inside the glass during the strokes
issues.what: the storm builds as uniform fog filling the globe evenly, with no directional slam or lag against the glass and no fold into one slow whirl; the die-down in set-D is an even fade rather than a single turning current losing speed
issues.fix: drive the spray to one side on the first stroke, let it lag the glass through the reversals, then consolidate into one visible whirl that slows and settles

issues.where: last C frame into the first frame of set-D-01.jpg
issues.what: a small brightness step in the fog clearing rate at the seam, interior mean jumps down between consecutive frames
issues.fix: smooth the clearing curve across the seam so the fog thins at a continuous rate
